notes.title: New DEMO Now Live! | Version: DEMO 2025.6.2
notes.notes:
New DEMO Now Live! | Version: DEMO 2025.6.2
Hello everyone!
I'm quan_home, a solo indie developer!

Thanks to all the valuable feedback from earlier players, I'm excited to announce that the completely reworked DEMO is now available!

 Try it now and share your thoughts—I’d love to hear your feedback!
 If you enjoy it, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist!
[hr][/hr]Key Updates in This Version:
Map size doubled – now supports over 30 minutes of gameplay (speedrun time)

 More logical weapon/item placement – no more “got a gun, nothing to shoot”

 New minimap icons – clearer navigation and objectives

 Enemy voice lines added – more immersive combat experience

 Save system implemented – save your progress at checkpoints

 Removed unfit weapons – smoother pacing and tighter gameplay

 New enemy types – more variety and challenge

 New and updated background music

 Improved settings menu

 Intro scene enhanced with new effects
[hr][/hr]Weapons and Items in the DEMO:
Bullets

Laser Bayonet

Teleport Shot

Zero-Gravity Round

Shotgun

Extended Backpack

DeepLink Disruptor

Signal Scanner

Repair Fluid

notes.title: A small update to the Demo today
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439460/2e3a98c2605c1fe107fd5b15371b92e80750d1b2.png
Based on feedback from enthusiastic players, I’ve made a small update to the Demo today.

The laser sword no longer requires equipment; it can be activated by pressing F while in the backpack.
Added storage boxes at two key locations.
Optimized and changed the number and location of some items.
Fixed the bug where the character's backpack would slide open when accessed.

Thank you for your support and feedback, and I hope you enjoy the game! 
Please leave feedback or suggestions if you have any, and once again, thank you!
